title: Procedural Core: A Compact Recurrent Initialization for Vision Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2609.37631v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transformers are typically trained from random initialization, requiring all their capabilities to emerge from large-scale optimization. Recent work showed that a small amount of abstract procedurally generated data can help acquire generic inductive structure at low cost. However, this adds a pretraining stage that must be repeated for every target model. We propose Procedural Core, an initialization strategy that captures this generic structure into a compact set of weights that can be reused across models. We train a minimal recurrent transformer on procedural data, then expand its weights to initialize transformers of arbitrary width and depth. The resulting initialization improves performance on image classification, self-supervised visual learning (DINO), and modeling natural language (FineWeb-Edu) and code (CodeParrot). For image classification, expanding a 1M-parameter core to initialize an 85M-parameter ViT-Base improves ImageNe

translated_title: Procedural Core：一种用于视觉Transformer的紧凑循环网络初始化方法
translated_abstract: Transformer通常从随机初始化开始训练，其所有能力都需要通过大规模优化才能涌现。近期研究表明，少量抽象的程序化生成数据能够以较低成本帮助模型获得通用的归纳结构。然而，这增加了一个预训练阶段，且该阶段必须针对每个目标模型重复进行。我们提出Procedural Core，这是一种初始化策略，它将这种通用结构捕获到一个紧凑的权重集合中，可在不同模型之间复用。我们在程序化数据上训练一个极简的循环Transformer，然后扩展其权重以初始化任意宽度和深度的Transformer。由此得到的初始化方法提升了图像分类、自监督视觉学习（DINO）、自然语言建模（FineWeb-Edu）和代码建模（CodeParrot）的性能。在图像分类任务中，将一个100万参数的核心扩展用于初始化8500万参数的ViT-Base，可提升ImageNe…（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Procedural Core，通过在程序化数据上训练极简循环Transformer并扩展其权重，形成一套可跨模型复用的紧凑初始化方案，能够提升Transformer在图像分类、自监督视觉学习以及语言和代码建模等任务上的性能。
